title: Microsoft × Mistral AI — Multibillion-Dollar European Sovereign AI Expansion
summary: Microsoft committed billions to fund Mistral AI data centre growth across Europe. Azure customers can develop software using Mistral’s France-based data centres, powered by thousands of NVIDIA Vera Rubin GPUs. Mistral Medium 3.5 and OCR 4 are now live on Microsoft Foundry and Copilot Studio. The partnership targets 1 GW of Mistral compute capacity by 2030 and enables sovereign deployment across public cloud, hybrid and fully disconnected environments.

title: AMD × Microsoft — Helios Rack-Scale AI System Deployed at Scale Across Azure
summary: AMD announced an expanded strategic partnership with Microsoft spanning GPUs, CPUs, networking and software on Azure. Microsoft will ramp AMD Helios at scale to power frontier model AI inference. Helios integrates AMD Instinct MI455X GPUs, EPYC Venice CPUs, Pensando networking and ROCm software. Microsoft joins Meta, OpenAI and Oracle as Helios customers. AMD shares rose nearly 5% on the announcement.

title: Humanoid × Schaeffler — Europe’s First Humanoid Robotics Unicorn: 52M Series A at .35B Valuation
companies: Humanoid, Schaeffler, Bosch, SAP, NVIDIA, Siemens
summary: UK-based Humanoid announced a 52 million Series A at a .35 billion valuation, becoming Europe’s first pure-play humanoid robotics unicorn. Humanoid signed the industry’s largest publicly announced commercial agreement with Schaeffler for large-scale deployment of thousands of humanoid robots in manufacturing. Robert Bosch Robotics GmbH also entered a manufacturing partnership. Beta robots roll out in Q4 2026.

title: NOBA Bank × Tieto Banktech — Verification of Payee Payment Security Across Nordic Operations
companies: NOBA Bank Group, Tieto Banktech, Bank Norwegian, Nordax Bank
summary: NOBA Bank Group partnered with Tieto Banktech to deploy Verification of Payee (VoP) capabilities across Bank Norwegian and Nordax Bank. The rollout covers the EPC VoP and Nordic VoP (NVOP) schemes, with Finland as the initial launch market, extendable across all NOBA territories.

title: ÆTHER Consortium — European AI Gigafactory in Strasbourg: SiPearl, 2CRSi, Dassault Systèmes, Nhood, SOCOMEC
companies: SiPearl, 2CRSi, Dassault Systèmes, Nhood, SOCOMEC, AETHER Infrastructures
summary: The European consortium ÆTHER unveiled its founding members and applied for the European Commission AI Gigafactory call. Members include SiPearl, 2CRSi, Dassault Systèmes, Nhood, SOCOMEC and Projex. ÆTHER is in advanced negotiations for two industrial sites in the Strasbourg region targeting 400 MW total capacity. The first campus (FR-SXB1) is expected to begin operations in 2027.

title: Leonardo × Baykar — LBA Systems JV: European Manufacturing of Advanced Drone Platforms
summary: LBA Systems — a 50/50 JV between Italy’s Leonardo and Turkey’s Baykar — achieved full operational readiness, announced at Farnborough Airshow. The JV integrates Leonardo avionics, radar and electronic warfare into Baykar’s TB2, AKINCI and KIZILELMA drone platforms. Manufacturing and servicing for Western markets will be executed at dedicated facilities in Italy.

title: EWE AG × Verbund — EC-Approved Green Hydrogen JV: 320 MW Electrolyser Linked to Germany’s Hydrogen Grid
companies: EWE AG, EWE Hydrogen GmbH, Verbund AG, Verbund Green Hydrogen GmbH
summary: The European Commission approved the 50/50 JV between Germany’s EWE AG and Austria’s Verbund AG. The JV centres on EWE’s €800 million Clean Hydrogen Coastline in Emden — a 320 MW electrolyser targeting 27,000 tonnes of green hydrogen annually by 2027, linked into Germany’s 9,000 km Wasserstoff-Kernnetz. Verbund contributes hydropower electrolysers and North Africa import routes.

title: Altris × Draslovka — Europe’s First Industrial Sodium-Ion Cathode Supply Chain
summary: Swedish battery developer Altris and Czech group Draslovka established Europe’s first industrial-scale sodium-ion cathode supply chain. Backed by €19.3 million strategic in-kind investment, a production line at Draslovka’s Kolín facility will yield up to 350 tonnes annually (~175 MWh) of Altris’ Prussian White Cathode Active Material (CAM) from Q3/Q4 2026, providing a European alternative to lithium for grid storage and urban mobility.

title: Saft (TotalEnergies) × Naval Group — Sovereign Li-Ion Batteries for Barracuda and Scorpene Submarines
summary: Saft, a TotalEnergies subsidiary, secured a major contract from Naval Group to supply lithium-ion battery systems for the Barracuda and Scorpene submarine classes. Transitioning from lead-acid chemistry, Saft’s defence-grade Li-ion technology extends underwater mission endurance and tactical stealth. Cell electrochemistry design and manufacturing are fully localised within France.

title: Ford × Geely — Valencia Manufacturing JV: 500,000-Unit EV and Multi-Energy Production from 2027
companies: Ford Motor Company, Geely Automobile Holdings
summary: Ford (66%) and Geely (34%) formed a manufacturing JV at Ford’s Valencia Almussafes plant in Spain, targeting 500,000 units per year from 2027. Products include a Ford multi-energy crossover, a European Ford Bronco and two all-electric Geely SUVs including the EX5. Made-in-Europe status enables Geely models to bypass EU import tariffs on Chinese-made EVs.

title: ielo × MIX (Milan Internet Exchange) — Direct France-Italy Fiber Peering Axis
summary: French fiber operator ielo partnered with Italy’s leading Internet Exchange Point MIX at the Via Caldera campus in Milan, establishing a direct France-Italy peering axis. Using active transport links across Lyon, Nice and Milan, European carriers can exchange traffic locally without routing through Northern European hubs, lowering latency and improving routing autonomy.

title: METLEN (M Technologies) × HOUTRIS — Military Land Vehicle Manufacturing JV in Cyprus
companies: METLEN Energy & Resources, M Technologies, HOUTRIS
summary: METLEN Energy & Resources, via defence unit M Technologies, entered an exclusive partnership with Cypriot manufacturer HOUTRIS to create a joint company dedicated to military land vehicle and defence systems production in Cyprus under the European SAFE programme.

title: Groupe BPCE × Nexity — Residential Real Estate Distribution Joint Venture in France
summary: Groupe BPCE and Nexity entered exclusive negotiations to form a joint venture combining Nexity’s iSelection and Perl subsidiaries with BPCE Solutions immobilières. The JV markets new and renovated homes to retail investors and first-time buyers through the Banque Populaire and Caisse d’Epargne networks, targeting launch by January 1, 2027.

title: SoftBank × Schneider Electric — €75B AI Data Centre Infrastructure Hub in France
summary: SoftBank Group committed €75 billion to build 5 gigawatts of AI data centre capacity across France, naming Schneider Electric as a primary strategic infrastructure partner. The partnership focuses on the physical AI supply chain: Schneider Electric will provide power management systems, thermal cooling, and robotics manufacturing for the first-phase site in Dunkirk.

title: Checkout.com × BLIK — Direct Scheme Integration Across Central & Eastern Europe
summary: Global digital payments processor Checkout.com became a direct scheme member and official partner of BLIK, Poland’s dominant mobile payment network. Embeds BLIK’s native app-to-checkout protocols and recurring payment functionality into Checkout.com’s European network, eliminating payment routing middlemen across Central and Eastern Europe.

title: AirPlus × Kresus Technologies × Mastercard — B2B Tail Spend Automation Alliance
summary: Corporate payment specialist AirPlus International formed a tripartite alliance with European B2B fintech Kresus Technologies and Mastercard to target corporate tail spend. Kresus’s cloud payment orchestration paired with AirPlus’s corporate billing and Mastercard’s global network provides European enterprises virtual card controls for automated indirect expenses.

title: Airbus × Mistral AI — European Sovereign Deep Tech AI Deployment
summary: Airbus signed a corporate-level deployment partnership with French AI firm Mistral AI, embedding Mistral’s full suite of generative AI models across commercial aviation, defence, space and helicopter systems. The data sovereignty strategy ensures classified military and aerospace operations run on trusted EU clouds rather than US hyperscaler infrastructure.

title: Adyen × ROLLER — ROLLER Capital: Embedded Finance for Leisure & Entertainment Venues
summary: Global fintech platform Adyen partnered with ROLLER to launch ROLLER Capital using Adyen’s embedded finance infrastructure. Thousands of European and UK entertainment venues can now access automated business loans directly inside their native venue management software, bypassing traditional banks.

title: Anthropic × Amazon & Google & Broadcom — Series H Infrastructure Alliances (10GW)
summary: Tied to Anthropic’s historic $65 billion Series H funding round (valuation: $965 billion), Anthropic signed multi-party infrastructure agreements: 5 GW with Amazon for dedicated energy and server capacity, and 5 GW with Google and Broadcom for next-generation TPU capacity — totalling 10 GW of dedicated AI compute.

title: Snowflake × AWS — $6B Enterprise Agentic AI Strategic Collaboration
summary: Snowflake signed a 5-year, $6 billion multi-year strategic collaboration with AWS, committing to AWS Graviton and Trainium compute for enterprise agentic AI. Alongside this, Snowflake announced a definitive agreement to acquire Natoma, an enterprise MCP governance platform. Snowflake stock surged 36%.

title: Centrica × SAP SE — Enterprise AI for Green Energy Trading & Grid Forecasting
summary: UK energy giant Centrica finalised a sweeping digital infrastructure partnership with SAP SE, integrating SAP’s Joule AI companion into Centrica’s corporate operations. The two companies are building unified data models to optimise green energy logistics, automate supply chain compliance, and deploy agentic AI for grid-readiness forecasting.

title: Snowflake × Natoma — MCP Governance Platform Acquisition for Enterprise AI Agents
summary: Alongside its $6B AWS deal, Snowflake signed a definitive agreement to acquire Natoma — an enterprise Model Context Protocol (MCP) platform — to add an identity and governance layer for AI agents operating across enterprise workflows.

title: EY × Microsoft — $1B+ Global Enterprise AI Initiative
summary: EY and Microsoft jointly committed over $1 billion across five years to move enterprise AI from pilot to production. Microsoft Forward Deployed Engineers will embed with EY professionals across finance, tax, HR and supply chain. EY is Client Zero, scaling Microsoft 365 Copilot across its 400,000+ global staff.

title: NextEra Energy × Caliber Resource Partners — $1.3B Acquisition + Shale JV
companies: NextEra Energy, Caliber Resource Partners, Quantum Capital Group
summary: NextEra Energy agreed to acquire Caliber Resource Partners for $1.3 billion and formed a shale JV with Quantum Capital Group to manage NextEra’s US shale assets. Signals NextEra expanding beyond renewables into gas to meet AI data centre power demand. NextEra targets 15 GW for data centres by 2035.

title: Anthropic × PwC — Expanded Strategic Alliance: Claude Across 364,000 Professionals
summary: PwC and Anthropic expanded their strategic alliance, deploying Claude Code and Cowork across PwC’s 364,000+ professionals across 136 countries. 30,000 US staff to be certified on Claude. Insurance underwriting compressed from 10 weeks to 10 days in production.

title: Blackstone × Skroutz — €635M Acquisition of Greece’s Leading Online Marketplace
summary: Blackstone agreed to acquire a majority stake in Skroutz from CVC Capital Partners Fund VII, valuing it at €635M including debt. Skroutz serves ~2.5M active users combining marketplace, last-mile logistics, fulfilment, fintech and retail media across Greece, Cyprus, Romania and Bulgaria.

title: OpenAI — The Development Company: $4B+ AI Professional Services Venture
summary: OpenAI raised over $4 billion for The Development Company from a 19-firm syndicate led by TPG. The vehicle competes directly with McKinsey, Bain and Capgemini as a consulting channel for enterprise AI deployment. OpenAI also acquired Tomoro for ~150 Forward Deployed Engineers.

title: Stellantis × Leapmotor — European EV Manufacturing: Chinese Tech, Spanish Production
summary: Stellantis and Leapmotor expanded from distribution JV to deep industrial manufacturing. Leapmotor B10 EV production moves to Zaragoza from 2026; a new Opel electric C-SUV follows from 2028 using Leapmotor architecture, bypassing EU tariffs on Chinese-made EVs.

title: Apple × Intel — Preliminary US Chip Manufacturing Agreement
summary: Apple and Intel reached a preliminary agreement for Intel to manufacture chips powering Apple devices — potentially M-series chips. Talks were facilitated by the US government, which holds a ~10% stake in Intel via the CHIPS Act. Diversifies Apple’s supply chain away from TSMC.

title: KPMG × ServiceNow — $40M AI Agent Enterprise Transformation Partnership
summary: KPMG and ServiceNow announced a multi-year $40M commitment to accelerate AI-powered enterprise transformation. KPMG UK is one of the first large European deployers of ServiceNow AI Agents in production, managing GBS workflows across HR, procurement and finance.

title: IBM × Aramco — Industrial AI Collaboration for Saudi Arabia’s Energy Sector
summary: IBM and Aramco formalised a collaboration to advance agentic AI, automation and materials science across Saudi Arabia’s industrial sector, combining IBM’s watsonx platform with Aramco’s 90 years of energy data. Aramco’s AI programmes contributed an estimated $2.6B in value in 2025.

title: SAP × Prior Labs — €1B Acquisition to Build EU Frontier AI Lab for Structured Data
summary: SAP agreed to acquire Freiburg-based Prior Labs and committed €1 billion over four years to build a globally leading frontier AI lab. Prior Labs pioneered Tabular Foundation Models for structured enterprise data. TabPFN downloaded 3M+ times. One of Germany’s largest-ever venture exits.

title: Pentagon × 8 AI Firms — Frontier AI on Classified Military Networks
companies: Pentagon, OpenAI, Google, Microsoft, Nvidia, AWS, SpaceX, Oracle, Reflection AI
summary: The US DoD signed agreements with eight leading AI firms to deploy frontier AI on IL6 (Secret) and IL7 (Top Secret) classified networks. Emil Michael (Pentagon CTO) confirmed 1.3 million DoD personnel are already using GenAI.mil.

title: EPH × TotalEnergies — TTEP: Europe’s 2nd Largest Flexible Power Generation JV (14 GW)
summary: EPH and TotalEnergies completed a 50/50 JV creating TTEP, operating 14 GW of flexible gas, biomass and battery storage across five EU markets. EPH received ~95.4 million TotalEnergies shares (4.2% stake). TTEP has a 5 GW project pipeline for battery energy storage and flexible gas.

title: Verda — €100M for European Sovereign AI Cloud Infrastructure
summary: Helsinki-based Verda (formerly DataCrunch) raised €100 million to scale its sovereign European AI cloud infrastructure, positioning itself as a GDPR-compliant EU-controlled alternative to US hyperscalers for AI compute.

title: ECB × ECPC, Nexo Standards & Berlin Group — Digital Euro Open Standards Partnership
companies: ECB, ECPC, Nexo Standards, Berlin Group
summary: The European Central Bank signed partnership agreements with Europe’s three main payment standards bodies to ensure the digital euro uses open, existing standards compatible with current payment infrastructure, providing regulatory certainty ahead of a potential 2029 issuance.

title: Lyft × Gett — Acquiring London’s Leading Black Cab App for ~$55M
summary: Lyft agreed to acquire Gett’s UK business for approximately $55 million, becoming the dominant app for London’s black cabs. Gett connects riders to three-quarters of Greater London’s registered black cab drivers. Combined with Freenow, Lyft will nearly double rides in London.

title: Nvidia × Google Cloud — AI Hypercomputer for Agentic & Physical AI Factories
summary: Nvidia and Google Cloud deepened their decade-long partnership at Google Cloud Next 2026, unveiling the AI Hypercomputer with new A5X bare-metal instances powered by Nvidia Vera Rubin NVL72. Delivers 10x lower inference cost per token and scales to ~960,000 Vera Rubin GPUs.

title: Merck × Google Cloud — $1B Agentic AI Enterprise Transformation
summary: Merck and Google Cloud announced a multi-year partnership valued at up to $1 billion to deploy Gemini Enterprise across Merck’s operations — R&D, manufacturing, commercial and corporate functions. Already cut reimbursement dossier preparation time and cost by half in live regulatory submissions.

title: Google Cloud $750M Partner AI Fund — Accenture, Deloitte, McKinsey & BCG
companies: Google Cloud, Accenture, Deloitte, McKinsey, BCG
summary: Google Cloud committed $750 million at Cloud Next 2026 to accelerate agentic AI adoption across its 120,000-member partner ecosystem. Accenture, BCG, Deloitte and McKinsey get early Gemini model access. 70+ pre-built agents launched in the new Agent Marketplace.

title: BANCOMAT × EPI × SIBS-MB WAY — Europe’s First Cross-Border QR Payment Interoperability
summary: Italy’s BANCOMAT, the European Payments Initiative (EPI/Wero) and Portugal’s SIBS/MB WAY signed Europe’s first cross-border QR code payment interoperability agreement. Italian and Portuguese consumers can now pay each other using their respective national payment apps via a shared QR standard.

title: Shopify × Stripe — Expanded Global Payments Partnership
summary: Shopify and Stripe expanded their global payments partnership, making Stripe the preferred payment processor for Shopify merchants worldwide. The deal deepens integration across checkout, fraud prevention and financial services, covering millions of merchants in 175+ countries.

title: Rheinmetall × Bundeswehr — €298M Attack Drone Contract for the German Military
summary: Germany’s parliament awarded Rheinmetall a contract to supply attack drones to the Bundeswehr worth approximately €298 million. The contract follows €536M in drone contracts awarded to Helsing and Stark Defence in February, drawing directly on lessons from Ukraine’s battlefield experience.

title: Capacity × Widem Logistics — US Fulfilment Player Enters EU via Strategic Partnership
summary: US-based Capacity LLC expanded into the EU through a strategic partnership with Widem Logistics, enabling in-region e-commerce fulfilment across multiple EU countries. Combines Capacity’s high-growth brand fulfilment expertise with Widem’s pan-European warehousing and customs clearance infrastructure.

title: Thoma Bravo × Google Cloud — AI Transformation for $300B+ Enterprise Software Portfolio
summary: The world’s largest software-focused PE firm and Google Cloud launched a strategic partnership giving Thoma Bravo’s entire portfolio — worth $300B+ — streamlined access to Gemini models, forward-deployed engineers and Google Cloud Marketplace co-sell routes.

title: EU EDF — €1.07B Invested in 57 Collaborative Defence R&D Projects
summary: The European Commission selected 57 collaborative R&D projects for €1.07 billion in EU Defence Fund investment, involving 634 entities from 26 EU member states. Flagship Project STRATUS develops an AI-powered cyber defence system for drone swarms. First time Ukrainian entities participate in EDF projects.

title: Novo Nordisk × OpenAI — AI Across Drug Discovery to Commercial Operations
summary: Novo Nordisk announced a strategic partnership with OpenAI to integrate advanced AI across the entire business — from drug discovery to commercial operations. Covers analysis of complex datasets, identifying drug candidates, manufacturing, supply chain and corporate functions. Pilot programmes launching in 2026.

title: Meta × CoreWeave — $21B AI Cloud Capacity Deal Through 2032
summary: Meta signed a fresh $21 billion agreement with CoreWeave for dedicated AI cloud capacity through December 2032, on top of the existing $14.2B deal. The multi-site deployment includes early Nvidia Vera Rubin GPU usage and powers Meta’s inference workloads for its Muse Spark AI model.

title: Joybuy × Competera — AI Pricing Automation for JD.com’s European Marketplace
summary: Joybuy — JD.com’s new European online retail platform — partnered with Competera’s AI pricing platform to automate competitive pricing intelligence across all EU markets. Teams receive real-time market insights daily to adjust prices, replacing manual spreadsheet-based monitoring.

title: Prologis × La Caisse — €1.6B Pan-European Logistics Joint Venture (PLIVE)
summary: Prologis and La Caisse launched PLIVE — a pan-European logistics joint venture with €1.6B in seed assets. La Caisse holds 70%, Prologis 30% as operating partner. The platform targets Europe’s key logistics corridors as reshoring, nearshoring and e-commerce drive structural demand.

title: Tredence × Google Cloud — Enterprise Agentic AI at Scale
summary: Tredence expanded its global strategic partnership with Google Cloud to help enterprises operationalise agentic AI at scale — moving beyond experimentation to production-grade AI deployment across financial services, retail, healthcare and regulated sectors.

title: IBM × Arm — Dual-Architecture Enterprise Computing for AI Workloads
summary: IBM and Arm announced a strategic collaboration to develop dual-architecture hardware for enterprises running AI and data-intensive workloads. Combines IBM’s Telum II processor and Spyre AI Accelerator with the Arm software ecosystem, targeting financial services, healthcare and government infrastructure.

title: Bain Capital × AQ Compute — Green AI Data Centre Buildout Across Europe
summary: Bain Capital acquired an 80% majority stake in AQ Compute from Germany’s Aquila Group to accelerate the buildout of green AI-ready data centres across Europe, offering modular colocation capabilities for hyperscale, cloud and AI customers.

title: LHV Bank × Gradient Labs — Europe’s First Agentic AI Banking Pilot
summary: LHV Bank launched a proof-of-concept with Gradient Labs — founded by ex-Monzo staff — to deploy AI agents for retail customer support. The pilot tests how explainable agentic AI can handle customer enquiries efficiently and consistently. One of Europe’s first live agentic AI banking deployments.

title: EU Signs Space Connectivity Agreement with Norway and Iceland for IRIS² and GOVSATCOM
summary: The EU signed a formal agreement allowing Norway and Iceland to join GOVSATCOM and IRIS², the EU’s sovereign satellite connectivity programme. Gives both countries access to secure satellite communications for crisis management, government operations and disaster response.

title: DHL eCommerce × Correios de Portugal — EU-Approved Joint Venture
summary: The European Commission unconditionally approved the DHL eCommerce and Correios de Portugal joint venture, combining DHL’s international parcel network with Portugal’s national postal infrastructure and strengthening last-mile delivery across the Iberian Peninsula.

title: Solaris × SBI Group — Europe’s First AI-Native Bank Transformation
summary: German Banking-as-a-Service platform Solaris repositioned as Europe’s first AI-native bank, backed by SBI Group. The transformation rebuilds banking processes using AI, with ADAC and Boerse Stuttgart as key live partners within the EU AI Act and DORA compliance frameworks.

title: Barclays × Sage — Embedded Finance Partnership for UK SMEs
summary: Barclays and Sage announced a strategic partnership integrating business banking with accounting software for UK SMEs. Addresses Making Tax Digital for Income Tax requirements while helping SMEs reduce the 24 working days per year typically lost to financial administration.

title: Visa Agentic Ready — 21 European Banks Launch AI Agent Payment Programme
companies: Visa, Barclays, HSBC UK, Commerzbank, Revolut, Santander, Nexi
summary: Visa launched its Agentic Ready programme in Europe, enrolling 21 issuing partners including Barclays, HSBC UK, Commerzbank, Revolut, Santander, Nexi and Nationwide to test AI agent-initiated payments in live production. Banco Santander completed Europe’s first live AI agent payment using a Visa credential in Spain.

title: JPMorgan Payments × Mastercard — B2B Virtual Card Launch in Europe
summary: JPMorgan Payments and Mastercard launched a new virtual card product across Europe targeting travel, healthcare, and accounts payable workflows, with Mastercard’s B2B Supplier Enablement & Activation Service to accelerate supplier onboarding onto digital payment programs.

title: OpenAI × AWS — AI Supply to US Government via AWS GovCloud
summary: OpenAI signed a partnership with AWS to distribute its AI products to US government agencies for both classified and unclassified workloads via AWS GovCloud and AWS Classified Regions. OpenAI retains control over which models are made available.

title: Mastercard × BVNK — $1.8B Stablecoin Infrastructure Acquisition
summary: Mastercard announced the acquisition of London-based BVNK for up to $1.8 billion. BVNK’s platform enables payments across all major blockchain networks in 130+ countries, processing over $25 billion annually. Positions Mastercard to connect traditional card rails, bank rails and stablecoins into a single unified network.

title: OpenAI × Booking.com — SME AI Accelerator Across 6 European Countries
summary: OpenAI partnered with Booking.com to launch an SME AI Accelerator programme, aiming to train 20,000 small businesses across France, Germany, Italy, Poland, Ireland, and the UK. Combines in-person workshops with virtual training on OpenAI Academy.

title: Visa × Fiserv — Expanded European Payments Platform Partnership
summary: Visa and Fiserv expanded their partnership to roll out the Visa Acceptance Platform across Fiserv’s merchant acquiring solutions in Europe, simplifying integration for acquirers, improving authorisation rates and giving merchants richer transaction data across online, in-store and contactless payments.

title: Nvidia Agent Toolkit — 17 Enterprise Platforms Adopt Open AI Agent Infrastructure at GTC 2026
companies: Nvidia, Salesforce, Adobe, SAP, ServiceNow, Siemens, Cisco, CrowdStrike, Atlassian
summary: At GTC 2026, Nvidia launched its open-source Agent Toolkit with 17 enterprise software platforms — including Salesforce, Adobe, SAP, ServiceNow, Siemens, Cisco, CrowdStrike and Atlassian — building next-generation AI agents on Nvidia’s shared infrastructure.

title: Meta × Nebius — $27B GPU Cloud Deal for Next-Gen AI Infrastructure
summary: Meta committed up to $27B to Nebius Group for five years of dedicated GPU cloud capacity, co-anchoring the commercial launch of Nvidia’s Vera Rubin GPU platform. Nvidia simultaneously announced a $2B investment in Nebius to build multiple gigawatt-scale AI factories in the US.

title: Telefónica Leads EURO-3C: 70+ Orgs Unite for Sovereign European Cloud & AI
summary: Telefónica announced EURO-3C at Mobile World Congress Barcelona — a European Commission-backed initiative joining 70+ telecoms and tech companies to build a federated sovereign cloud, AI, and edge infrastructure across Europe, reducing dependency on US cloud infrastructure.

title: EU × Switzerland — Landmark Bilateral Agreements Modernising Single Market Access
summary: The EU and Switzerland signed updated bilateral agreements (Bilaterals III) on March 2, 2026, modernising one of Europe’s most important partnerships. The deal smooths access to the EU’s 460 million consumer market for Swiss businesses and aligns rules across transport, free movement and mutual recognition.

title: EPC Wero Expands Retail Payments to France and Belgium After Germany Launch
companies: European Payments Council, Wero, Lidl, Decathlon
summary: The European Payments Council’s Wero platform, already live in Germany with Lidl, Decathlon and Rossmann, is expanding retail payment partnerships into France and Belgium in 2026. With 1,100+ participating financial institutions, Wero is Europe’s answer to reducing Visa/Mastercard dependency.

title: Amazon × OpenAI — $50B Investment + $100B AWS Cloud Expansion
summary: Amazon and OpenAI announced a landmark multi-year strategic partnership: Amazon investing $50B in OpenAI while expanding their cloud agreement by $100B over 8 years. AWS becomes the exclusive third-party cloud distributor for OpenAI Frontier, with OpenAI committing to 2 GW of Trainium chip capacity.

title: Tieto × Orange Business — Multi-Year Cloud Infrastructure Deal
summary: Nordic tech company Tieto signed a multi-year frame agreement with Orange Business, migrating all four of its business units to Orange Business’s sovereign European cloud platform Cloud Avenue. Tieto Banktech will begin cloud migrations in H2 2026.

title: Accenture × Mistral AI — Multi-Year Enterprise AI Collaboration
summary: Accenture and Paris-based Mistral AI announced a multi-year strategic collaboration to scale sovereign, enterprise-grade AI across Europe and globally. Accenture will train thousands of professionals on Mistral AI’s models and embed Mistral’s technology into client solutions with a focus on regulatory compliance and data sovereignty.

title: Adyen × Starbucks — In-Store Payments Across 940+ European Stores
summary: Adyen rolled out its unified payment infrastructure across 943 Starbucks locations in the UK, Austria, and Switzerland, deploying 2,375 payment terminals with Store and Forward technology ensuring uninterrupted payments during network outages.

title: OpenAI × ServiceNow — Multi-Year Enterprise AI Platform Partnership
summary: OpenAI and ServiceNow expanded their multi-year strategic partnership to embed OpenAI’s models natively into the ServiceNow platform, enabling AI-powered automation across enterprise workflows for HR, IT, customer service and finance functions at global enterprise scale.
